name: Watercress

facts.how: Raw as the classic peppery salad green

caution: Harvest ONLY from clean, flowing water you know is unpolluted; cress from water near livestock or runoff can carry parasites. When in doubt, cook it. Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: Rounded compound leaves floating and trailing in cold spring runs, with a sharp peppery bite. Grows right in the water.

sections.title: In the kitchen
sections.body: The original salad cress, brilliant raw. Because it grows in water, source is everything: only clean flowing springs.
